questions.questionText: Tissue responsible for transporting water and minerals from roots in plants:
questions.explanation: Xylem carries water unidirectional from roots upward.

questions.questionText: Plant hormone responsible for stem elongation and seed germination:
questions.explanation: Gibberellins stimulate cell division and germination.

questions.questionText: Pores on leaves through which gas exchange and transpiration occur:
questions.explanation: Stomata guarded by guard cells regulate gas diffusion.

questions.questionText: Gaseous plant hormone promoting fruit ripening:
questions.explanation: Ethylene gas triggers fruit softening and ripening.

questions.questionText: Double fertilization is unique feature of:
questions.explanation: Angiosperms undergo double fertilization forming zygote & endosperm.
